description: Saves answers and program choices to the founder’s own Programscape plan: new or changed answers, programs to keep, programs to set aside. Creates their first plan if they have none. Only what is sent changes; everything else in the plan (notes, progress, contacts) stays as it is.

answers.description: New or changed answers the founder gave, keyed by question field as in a review’s answers.

keep.description: Program ids the founder wants to keep in their plan.

planId.description: Which saved plan, if the founder has more than one. Leave out for their most recent.

setAside.description: Program ids the founder wants to set aside.

name: update_my_plan
title: Update the founder’s saved plan
